articles.title: Immunotherapy combination extends survival in advanced endometrial cancer
articles.excerpt: An immunotherapy-based regimen combining durvalumab and the PARP inhibitor olaparib demonstrated encouraging long-term survival outcomes for patients with advanced or recurrent endometrial cancer, according to new trial results presented by researchers from The University of Texas MD Anderson Cancer
articles.summary: 会议公布的试验结果显示，durvalumab联合PARP抑制剂olaparib在晚期或复发性子宫内膜癌患者中带来长期生存获益。
